estimates.name: Income Taxes
estimates.t: We record income tax provisions in our consolidated financial statements based on an estimate of current income tax liabilities.

estimates.name: Assessment of Long-lived Assets for Impairment
estimates.t: We review long-lived assets, including operating lease assets, for impairment whenever events or circumstances indicate the carrying amount of an asset may not be fully recoverable based on estimated undiscounted future cash flows.

estimates.name: Assessment of Goodwill and Indefinite-Lived Intangible Assets for Impairment
estimates.t: In assessing these types of assets for impairment, there are significant estimates and assumptions used to determine the fair value, including relevant market and economic conditions, anticipated future revenues and cash flows, royalty rates, and discount rates.
